title: Chapter 1399
text:
While Han Xiao was eating lemons, Fu Ding, who was in the Soul Terminal, had already started working.

Feidin took out the Soul Swapper and activated his ability. Immediately, an invisible suction force was generated, and the soul residue in the surrounding area suddenly slowed down as they flew toward the nebula vortex. In the end, they changed directions and flew toward the starship he was on.

The nebula vortex had a natural attraction force for soul residue. Fu Ding's actions were no different from 'snatching food from a tiger's mouth'. However, this secondary dimension did not seem to have a dimensional consciousness, so no one cared about him.

Streaks of soul residue were absorbed by the black, crystal-like surface of the Soul Swap Instrument. The remaining thoughts were extracted and refined into pure, sparkling and translucent soul energy.

Fu Ding extracted the results of the Soul Swapper through the soul connection, wrapped it with his psychic energy, and digested it into his brain. He felt refreshed, and there were no side effects like the memories and emotional impact that he usually suffered when using psychic energy to explore other people's thoughts. He could clearly feel that his psychic energy was being cleansed, and the cells in his body were cheering.

He could clearly feel that his body was gradually transforming. It was like an extremely thirsty person continuously drinking clear and sweet spring water. He was filled with a sense of satisfaction from head to toe. It gave him a feeling even more comfortable than spiritual intercourse, and he could not help but indulge in it.

When his body and mind were closely connected to the Soul Swapper, the psychic power that reverberated around Feidin was stained with even more deep black. He obtained a new level of support from the Soul Swapper, and his characteristics were strengthened and became even more pure. This gave him a thrilling pleasure that made his soul tremble.

"Hu …"

Fu Ding could not help but let out a sigh of relief. It was as if he had entered a state of unconscious cultivation, and the cells in his body were gradually transitioning toward the Beyond Grade A level.

With him as the center, a gray vortex that was countless times smaller formed, reflecting the enormous nebula vortex. The large and small vortex slowly rotated at the same speed in opposite directions.

After confirming that Fu Ding was not in danger, Han Xiao did not disturb him and turned around to continue his unfinished research.

…

Very soon, a month passed in the blink of an eye.

On this day, Han Xiao arrived at the training ground square early in the morning.

Not long ago, Fu Ding had finally ended his month-long cultivation and had already broken through to the Beyond Grade A realm. Only then did he remember to send a message saying that he was coming back, so Han Xiao waited there.

Black Star's figure was seen by a Calamity Grade student who happened to pass by. He could not help but stop and look over with a strange gaze, curious about who Black Star was waiting for.

Not long after, there was a flash of light, and the shuttle appeared out of thin air, jumping from the secondary dimension world back to the main universe and landing in the square.

The cabin door opened and Fu Ding walked out. As soon as he saw Han Xiao, he showed a happy smile and strode forward to greet him.

Compared to a month ago, his aura had undergone a huge change. Just his simple walk made the hearts of the curious Calamity Grade students tighten. They felt an instinctive sense of oppression. It was the pressure of a high-level life form.

At this moment, the Calamity Grades present suddenly understood something and were shocked. They did not care that Han Xiao was right beside them and surrounded him.

"Fu Ding, you've already become a Beyond Grade A?"

"I haven't seen you in the base during this time, and I was still curious about where you went. I didn't expect you to sublimate without a word. Not bad!"

"Quick, share your experience. What kind of feeling is that?"

Fu Ding was surrounded by a large group of people and could only stop. He looked at Han Xiao across the crowd and revealed a helpless smile.

His Charm attribute was extremely high, and his personality was not one to offend people. Thus, he was quite popular. Even though he had become a Beyond Grade A, he did not have the mentality of being superior to others and did not push the crowd away.

The Calamity Grades present were still calling their friends. Figures wrapped in streams of light jumped around the base, quickly approaching from afar. At the same time, several teleportation gates appeared beside them. A large group of Calamity Grades who had received the news rushed over and surrounded them. More and more people gathered, and the scene was as noisy as a market.

Han Xiao, who was outside the crowd, coughed and suppressed everyone's voices.

He smiled and said, "Fu Ding has indeed advanced to the Beyond Grade A realm. He's the first student to successfully break through during the training. It's only been two to three months since the training began. This is a very good start."

After receiving the exact information, everyone could not help but reveal envious expressions and congratulate Fu Ding.

Sounds of congratulations immediately rang out from the crowd. Some of them were sincere, while others were jealous.

Fu Ding sighed and explained with a gentle voice, "Everyone, I managed to get through some lucky encounters.

I'm afraid my experience is not applicable to everyone. There's no point in using it as a reference. "

Of course, which normal person would not be constipated when they advanced to the Beyond Grade A realm? Yin Ying even went into seclusion for close to a hundred years at this step. Only a cheat like you can do it as easily as eating and drinking …

Han Xiao secretly complained.

This time, Fu Ding saw the looks of pity on everyone's faces. He thought for a moment and smiled.

"However, I can let everyone experience my strength after my advancement and replicate my senses during my ascension …"

As he spoke, he closed his eyes and opened his mouth. A melodious psychic song swept out and covered everyone present.

The Calamity Grade students were instantly energized, and they instantly obtained the comprehension of Fu Ding's advancement. At the same time, they also realized that the beautiful psychic song that directly sounded in their souls had aroused their emotions, and they were subconsciously immersed in it.

The next moment, a positive energy quickly surged from the bottom of their hearts. Everyone's hearts were instantly filled with the desire to train. They could not wait to go into seclusion and train hard. It was as if they had used stimulants, and they became quite energetic.

Han Xiao purposely released his mental barrier and tested Fu Ding's psychic ability after his advancement. When he saw the combat information on the interface, he could not help but raise his brows.

Fu Ding specialized in the psychic path. The fortuitous encounter of his advancement this time had caused his ability to undergo a considerable transformation. His psychic song had merged with the special characteristics of the Soul Swapper, and his psychic ability had increased tremendously. He could now more efficiently trigger the emotions and desires of living beings, achieving a strong hypnotic effect. Every time he triggered a different emotion, the target would enter the relevant state.

At this moment, everyone was full of enthusiasm. Fu Ding had used his psychic song to trigger everyone's motivation, and what appeared in the status bar was the effect of increasing the efficiency of gaining experience. If it was used on others, it would increase the efficiency of their cultivation!

Han Xiao instantly thought of the role Fu Ding could play. Although Fu Ding's current Grade was not high, and he was not good at fighting head-on, he could bring a large range of buffs and debuffs to his teammates or enemies. This was more useful than his own combat ability.

"A powerful support is much more valuable than an ordinary Beyond Grade A Super. Just this ability alone is enough to make him popular. He won't be at the bottom … Most importantly, he can increase the training efficiency of others without any side effects. With his help, we might be able to produce more Beyond Grade As …"

Various thoughts flashed through Han Xiao's mind, and he was overjoyed.

This time, his gaze suddenly paused. He realized that in the crowd that was brimming with enthusiasm, there was an extremely eye-catching figure. His face was still gloomy, forming a stark contrast with the people around him.

This figure was like a firefly in the dark night, so bright and outstanding. Who else could it be other than Lagi?

Han Xiao was curious. "Hey, Fu Ding, this move of yours doesn't seem to work on him."

Hearing this, Feidin turned to look at Lagi and was taken aback.

"That's not right. This move of mine shouldn't be ineffective against Calamity Grades, right?"

As he spoke, Fu Ding once again released a psychic song to motivate Lagi.

Lagi's spirit instantly rose. He was no longer hunched, and his posture was as straight as a javelin. His entire temperament changed drastically, and his eyes were filled with vigor.

"Isn't this effective … hmm?"

Before Feidin could finish his sentence, he saw that Lagi's state only lasted for a few seconds. Lagi's high-spirited aura suddenly leaked out like a balloon. In the blink of an eye, he returned to his original decadent state, and he switched back to his lifeless, dead fish mode. It was like the difference between breathing in and relaxing.

"What are you …"

Fu Ding opened his mouth and was a little confused.

This kind of motivational state usually lasted for a few days, but how did it disappear in just a few seconds on Lagi?

He did not give up and wanted to try again, but Lagi stopped him with reluctance written all over his face.

"Don't torture me. This is all futile. Sigh, even if you become a Beyond Grade A, you won't be able to free me. Just let me rot in a corner quietly …"

Tsk, what a familiar Trash Person, what beautiful Lagi words …

Han Xiao's heart twitched as he listened. He sized Lagi up and made a bold guess.

"Hmm, I think I understand. Your motivational ability is only similar to hypnosis after all, not brainwashing. It can't change the personality of others, so it's different when you trigger different emotions … Maybe Lagi is immune to this kind of mental stimulation?"

As he spoke, Han Xiao felt that he had guessed the truth.

It was definitely because Lagi's values were too f * cking firm. A short period of motivation would only be broken down in an instant. It was like drinking a mouthful of chicken soup and deciding to work hard the next day, but the next day, he would still be playing cards and sleeping.

Fu Ding felt that it made sense and probed, "Then, why don't I try to stimulate his dispirited emotions and see if your guess is right?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

"Better not. He's already dispirited enough. If you make things worse for him, I'm afraid he'll kill himself on the spot."

"… That's reasonable."

Fu Ding was speechless.

The Calamity Grade students present had obtained the experience they wanted. Seeing that Han Xiao and Fu Ding still had something to say, they all tactfully left and went to train their abilities with full enthusiasm. Very soon, only the two of them were left in the square.

With no one else around, Han Xiao walked in front of Fu Ding, patted him on the shoulder, and said with relief, "Congratulations.

You've already left your name in the Sanctum. As long as I'm still alive, death will stay away from you. "

Fu Ding smiled and said, "My fortuitous encounter this time came from the Soul Swapper, and if not for you, I wouldn't have obtained this Universal Treasure. Thank you."

"You don't have to be so polite with me." Han Xiao waved his hands and said, "Speaking of which, you don't have a nickname yet, right? I'll think of one for you. How about we call you Singer? How appropriate."

Singer was Fu Ding's nickname in his previous life. Although his life experience this time was completely different, in Han Xiao's opinion, this nickname was still suitable for Fu Ding.

"Alright, then I'll call you a singer."

Fu Ding smiled, indicating that he accepted this nickname. He then retracted his smile and explained what he had experienced this time without leaving out anything.

Although he guessed that Black Star might already know, he still told him.

After hearing Fu Ding's explanation, Han Xiao smiled and nodded.

"I understand. This is your own opportunity. Even if you become a Beyond Grade A, you can continue to use that place to quickly increase your strength. You have to grasp it well."

"Of course … By the way, the Soul Terminal is also beneficial to Hella. I can only digest the soul residue with the help of external objects, but Hella is born with this ability. Her growth speed there might be faster than mine. Ask her what she thinks. Anyway, the soul residue there is endless, and the part I can digest is not worth mentioning."

"It's hard for you to think of her. I think she'll be very happy."

The more Han Xiao looked at Fu Ding, the more he admired him.

Suppressing his impulse, Han Xiao coughed and said, "I'll inform her about the Underworld now.

"I'll go inform Hila now. She's still training in the Underworld. I'll need you to bring her there. After all, you're the one who found this place. Without your permission, I won't give the coordinates to anyone."

With that, Han Xiao changed into the King and teleported away.

Fu Ding watched Han Xiao leave and clenched his fists. An inexplicable emotion reverberated in his heart. He exhaled softly and muttered to himself, "You've protected me for hundreds of years.

"You've protected me for nearly a hundred years. Now, it's finally my turn to help you …"
